messages:
anna.docs: Hey team — I have a docs PR that needs to ship for a customer migration (PR #4821). It’s mostly copy edits, two SDK snippets (Python + TS), and a couple of broken links found in the migration guide. Can I get a merge slot in tomorrow’s docs merge window? The docs-preview is failing right now so I can't get a green check.

matt.engineering: @anna.docs thanks for the heads up. Can you paste the failing preview link? I can take a quick look at the build error.

anna.docs: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/4821 — build log shows mkdocs failure on a bad anchor and a warning treated as error from our linter: `LINK: /platform/migrate#auth -> 404` and `docs-lint: terminology: 'end-user' discouraged, prefer 'customer'`.

docs-ci: preview build failed: mkdocs 1.4.2 build error at docs/migrate/auth.md: unresolved reference to "#auth". Also docs-lint: 1 error (terminology), 2 warnings.

liz.devex: For the terminology lint, we have a standing rule: use 'customer' for external-facing docs, 'user' only when referring to internal product personas. Do not use 'end-user'. If the text is ambiguous, prefer 'customer'. @anna.docs can you replace occurrences?

anna.docs: Yep — I can change 'end-user' -> 'customer' across the PR. The anchor error looks like a heading rename in the target doc — I'll restore the correct anchor and push a tiny fix.

matt.engineering: On the snippets: quick sanity check — the Python snippet uses our new client import `from redwood import RedwoodClient` but the TS one still has `import { Redwood } from '@redwoodai/sdk'`. Can we standardize to the consolidated examples we agreed in the style guide? (Python: `RedwoodClient()`, TS: `new RedwoodClient()`).

anna.docs: Good catch. I updated both to the canonical forms and added a comment to show async usage for TS.

tom.reviewer: I can review after the link/terminology fixes. Please also add a brief note in the PR description about backwards-incompatible behavior (none in this change) and a changelog blurb.

sara.product: Heads up — this migration doc is customer-impacting for AcmeCorp; would prefer the PR merged in the first merge slot tomorrow to coincide with their cutover. If CI can be green we'll want to merge at 09:00 PST.

liz.devex: Reminder for style: keep imperative voice in steps, prefer concrete examples over conceptual text in the migration checklist, and avoid Oxford comma inconsistency — we use Oxford commas in docs. Also ensure config keys are formatted in inline code, e.g., `api_key`, not ApiKey.

anna.docs: Pushed fixes: anchor restored, all 'end-user' -> 'customer', snippets standardized, PR description updated with changelog blurb and rollout timing. Triggering preview again.

docs-ci: preview build started...

docs-ci: preview build completed — success. mkdocs: OK. lint: 0 errors, 1 warning (long line in code sample).

tom.reviewer: Quick review done. Left one tiny nit about wording in the first step (prefer 'set up an API key' -> 'create an API key'). Otherwise LGTM.

anna.docs: Fixed wording, shortened a long line in the code sample. Thanks all.

matt.engineering: Approving now. @tom.reviewer do you want to do the official review/approve?

tom.reviewer: Approved.

anna.docs: Thanks — requesting merge at 09:00 PST slot tomorrow per Sara's ask. I added a note in the PR about the customer cutover and a rollback plan (revert PR if needed, no DB changes).

liz.devex: One off-process note for the team: I updated the style-guide checklist in the handbook to call out the 'customer' vs 'user' rule and canonical snippet patterns. We'll batch a small lint rule to catch `end-user` next sprint.

sara.product: Appreciated. I’ll coordinate with AcmeCorp on the timing.

anna.docs: Closing the thread — thanks everyone. Will merge in slot if no hot objections before 09:00 PST. :thumbsup:
